company.name: Risely AI
company.shortDescription: Risely AI offers an AI-driven platform that supports, engages, and retains students in higher education.
company.description: Risely AI provides an AI-powered advising platform that helps higher education institutions identify at-risk students, personalize outreach, and streamline student success workflows. The AI Advisor collects and organizes student data from all campus systems. It identifies students who need attention and suggests actions. The system drafts emails and messages for student outreach. The platform follows security and compliance standards for student records. It integrates with campus systems quickly, allowing teams to start using it in days.
